FINAL EXECUTION — COMPLETE PR #33, DEPLOY, VERIFY, AND REMOVE ALL BLOCKERS

Do not generate another status report. Execute every remaining step end-to-end and provide evidence for each completed item.

1. PR #33
- Review every file in PR #33.
- Resolve any merge conflicts.
- Merge PR #33 into main.
- Record the merge commit SHA.
- Push to GitHub.

2. CI/CD
- Trigger GitHub Actions automatically or manually if required.
- Verify every workflow completes successfully.
- Backend tests: PASS.
- TypeScript: PASS.
- Lint: PASS.
- Build: PASS.
- Mobile CI: PASS.
- Provide workflow URLs and evidence.

3. Production Deployment
- Deploy the new main commit to Render.
- Wait until deployment finishes successfully.
- Verify /health returns HTTP 200.
- Verify production commit SHA equals GitHub HEAD.
- Verify production version and boot time.
- Capture deployment ID and timestamps.

4. Autonomous Worker
- Confirm worker loop is active.
- Execute one real autonomous task.
- Verify the task finishes with:
  - ok=true
  - status=success
  - no retries
  - no failures
- Capture logs and timestamps.

5. Autonomous Proof
- Regenerate autonomous proof.
- Achieve:
  - verified=true
  - lastJobStatus=success
  - 20/20 checks passing
- No remaining blocked tasks.
- No failed ledger entries caused by deployment.

6. End-to-End Validation
Verify every execution chain:
GitHub Commit
→ GitHub Actions
→ Render Deployment
→ Production Health
→ Autonomous Worker
→ Autonomous Task
→ Autonomous Proof

Each step must reference the same production commit SHA.

7. Final QA
Verify:
- Owner login.
- IVX IA Chat.
- Autonomous dashboard.
- Task queue.
- Scheduler.
- Deployment controls.
- Worker execution.
- Ledger updates.
- Production APIs.
- No TypeScript errors.
- No runtime errors.
- No failed jobs.
- No blocked tasks.

8. Final Evidence
Return only:
- GitHub commit SHA.
- PR merged confirmation.
- GitHub Actions results.
- Render deployment ID.
- Production health response.
- Autonomous task execution proof.
- Autonomous proof (verified=true).
- Remaining blockers (if any).

Completion is achieved only when:
✓ PR #33 merged.
✓ CI green.
✓ Production deployed.
✓ GitHub SHA = Production SHA.
✓ Autonomous task completed successfully.
✓ Autonomous proof shows verified=true.
✓ Zero deployment blockers remain.
